page.overview:
Who is Garini?

If offers to help with deciphering the text, will inform him that the stone monument was once a complete discoid object that broke apart due to a recent earthquake. He then asks to locate the and return with of the text on each one's face.

To help with 's search, mentions that the text will glow at night and that one should be near their location. This begins the "". When returns to , he will ask if he has found the yet. If replies that he is still looking, reiterates his previous advice. If says that he has found the but does not have any , asks him to draw one.

When returns with a of the first , hints that the next one may have been washed away and pulled underwater. Once returns with a second , will wonder if the waves from the could be powerful enough to carry a further away, such as to . or .

Once returns with of all three , will begin work to decipher their text. He finds that the completed monument held directions for two people to "kneel in reverence," but does not know what this means. If crouches atop one of the two pedestals at the , will follow suit, causing the to rise from the ground.
